game.title: Olinda Keliya
game.description: A traditional board game played with olinda seeds, popular among women. Similar to mancala games, involving strategy and counting skills.
howToPlay: Step 1: The board has rows of pits carved into wood.
Step 2: Fill each pit with a specific number of olinda seeds.
Step 3: Players take turns picking up seeds from one pit and distributing them.
Step 4: Capturing seeds based on where the last seed lands.
Step 5: Game continues until all seeds are captured.
Step 6: Player with most seeds wins.
Step 7: Requires counting and strategic planning.
Step 8: Traditionally played by women during leisure time.
Step 9: Seeds have cultural and medicinal significance.
